modern: Nature has had regard in everything no less to the end than to the beginning and the continuation, just like the man who throws up a ball. What good is it, then, to the ball to be thrown up, or what harm for it to come down, or even to have fallen? And what good is it to the bubble while it holds together, or what harm when it has burst? The same may be said of a lamp too.
